register_phi_4_models: register Microsoft Phi-4 base models into the Unsloth model registry
register_phi_4_instruct_models: register Microsoft Phi-4 instruct models into the Unsloth model registry
register_phi_models: register all Microsoft Phi-4 models including base and instruct variants into the Unsloth model registry
construct_model_name: construct a model name key from base name, version, size, quantization type, and instruct tag for Phi models
run_phi_registry_validation: run the Unsloth Phi model registry validation script to check all registered Phi model entries
